Relationship between DEGs and the MAPK pathway was elucidated using WikiPathways software

The relationship between DEGs and the MAPK pathway was elucidated using WikiPathways software. The two differentially expressed genes shown in the image are TYROBP and ITGB2, with the regulatory signals highlighted in red. (For interpretation of the references to colour in this figure legend, the reader is referred to the web version of this article.)
Download JPG
View figure at PMC Read paper at PMC

Publication

Bioinformatics and experimental validation of MAPK pathway activation in diabetic kidney disease induced by glucose variability (2025) Sujuan Li, et al. J Genet Eng Biotechnol. 2025 Dec;23(4). Figure: F16.
